title: Girlfriend got a goodbye text, boyfriend not answering

transcript.text: My boyfriend just sent me a text that says 'sorry for everything, I love you, goodbye'. He's not answering.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I think at his flat, Vildandsvägen 7 in Lund. I'm in Malmö.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Has he talked about hurting himself before?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: He tried once before, with pills. He's been really down since he lost his job.

transcript.speaker: operator

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: What's his name, age and phone number?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Jonas, 29. I'll send you the number. Please hurry.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: I'm sending police and an ambulance to the flat now. Keep trying to call him, and stay on this line.
